customManagers.description: The deployment contract carries the runtime base image as a literal that tests/unit/test_deployment/test_contract.py requires to match the Dockerfile's runtime FROM. No built-in manager reads it, so without this a base-image digest PR changes only the Dockerfile and fails that test.

packageRules.description: Held on their current lines until after GA: their next releases change behaviour the engine relies on. The reason for each hold sits beside its dependency in pyproject.toml.
